name: hcapp_syncKennelAdminData
description: Incremental pull-sync SP for kennel admin data. Returns up to 5 optional result sets based on which 'updatedAfter' cursors are not 'ignore'. Scoped to a specific @kennelId. Has a wrong error message — the null @kennelId error says 'Null or empty eventId'. @targetHasherId scopes the Payments and HasherEventMap result sets.

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for Hashers (not kennel-scoped). 'ignore' = skip. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: kennelsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for Kennels (all kennels). 'ignore' = skip. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HasherKennelMap (scoped to @kennelId). 'ignore' = skip. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: targetHasherId
parameters.description: When provided, scopes Payments and HasherEventMap result sets to this specific hasher.

parameters.name: usePaging
parameters.description: Default 0 (unlimited). When non-zero, limits to 1000/250 rows.

parameters.name: procName
parameters.description: Override SP name for token validation.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: Override device secret for token validation.

rowsets.name: NullKennelError
rowsets.description: Standard error format. errorType=2. NOTE: errorTitle says 'Null or empty eventId' — wrong, should be 'Null or empty kennelId'.

rowsets.name: Kennels
rowsets.description: Emitted when @kennelsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. All kennels updated since watermark (not scoped to @kennelId). Includes full kennel profile: banking info, payment schemes (3 schemes), city/country join for lat/lon. Page size: 250.

rowsets.name: HasherKennelMap
rowsets.description: Emitted when @hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. HKM records for @kennelId updated after watermark. Uses stored IsMember column (not computed, unlike syncEventAdminData). Page size: 250.

columns.name: isMember
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.IsMember — the stored column (NOT computed, unlike syncEventAdminData).

columns.name: (full HKM column list)
columns.description: All HKM columns — see syncEventAdminData contract for the complete list.

rowsets.name: Hashers
rowsets.description: Emitted when @hashersUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. Same structure as syncEventAdminData Hashers. Page size: 1000.

rowsets.name: Payments
rowsets.description: Emitted when @paymentsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. Payments scoped to @targetHasherId (not to @kennelId). Same columns as syncEventAdminData Payments.

rowsets.name: HasherEventMap
rowsets.description: Emitted when @hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. HEM records scoped to @targetHasherId. Note: hemEventStartDatetimeGmt appears twice with slightly different derivation (second occurrence uses FbEventStartDatetime for Gmt when UseFbRunDetails=1).

columns.name: (similar to syncEventAdminData HasherEventMap)
columns.description: See syncEventAdminData.HasherEventMap for column details. Additional: hemCountryId.

codeSmells.issue: Wrong error title for null kennelId — says 'eventId'
codeSmells.detail: The null @kennelId validation says ErrorName='Null or Empty EventId'. Should be 'Null or Empty KennelId'.

codeSmells.issue: isMember inconsistency: stored column here vs computed in syncEventAdminData
codeSmells.detail: syncKennelAdminData returns the stored IsMember bit; syncEventAdminData computes it from MembershipExpirationDate > today. These can diverge.

codeSmells.issue: Payments and HEM scoped to @targetHasherId — may return data outside @kennelId
codeSmells.detail: When @targetHasherId is set, Payments are filtered by UserId=@targetHasherId with no kennelId restriction. Could return payments from other kennels.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the 'ignore' sentinel without updating all callers
